author: sourcery-ai[bot]
body: **issue (bug_risk):** The arguments to `remove` are swapped. `HoldQueue.remove` takes the card number first and the ISBN second, so every cancel looks up the wrong hold and will always be rejected.

author: sourcery-ai[bot]
body: **issue (reliability):** Catching every error from the queue and returning `rejected` turns an unavailable queue into a member mistake. The caller cannot tell "you have no hold" from "the queue is down", and the second case is exactly what should reach the caller as a failure. Consider letting the error propagate (or returning a distinct failure status) and dropping the test that pins the current behaviour.

author: m-okafor
body: When the first hold in a title's queue is cancelled, the next member in line should be told their hold is now first. Can this reuse the reminder channels in notifications/? Otherwise staff will keep getting asked "am I next yet".

author: sourcery-ai[bot]
body: **suggestion (security):** The rejection reason interpolates the member's full card number into a message that will end up in logs and on screen. Mask it, for example to the last four digits.

author: sourcery-ai[bot]
body: **suggestion:** Consider renaming `run` to `execute`, which makes the use-case entry point clearer to readers coming from other codebases.
